current.text: He is projected to start for Cleveland next to Donovan Mitchell, Peyton Watson, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen.
His usage, shot attempts, free throw attempts and scoring dropped after he joined Cleveland. He averaged under 20 points there and plays more as a distributor next to Mitchell, Mobley and Watson.
Over his last six games in Cleveland he played about 33 minutes with a usage rate of about 24 to 25, and his assists and FG% dropped.
Experts do not expect his lower usage to reverse. He will probably not repeat 35 minutes a night or last season's finish, and one expert sees the start of an end-of-career drop-off.
Cleveland's second unit has no clear point guard, so Harden and Mitchell may stagger their minutes.
He is no longer a first or second round player. Pick 26 is too early. The fair range in category leagues is about picks 28 to 40, which is the end of round three in a 12-team league.
His ESPN rank and ADP in the low to mid 20s are too high. A Yahoo rank around 30 is fine for category leagues.
In a recent mock draft he slid to pick 40, the latest the speaker had seen him go.
In an auction mock he went for 24 USD. The expert expected the low to mid 20s and called his value all over the place.
Experts rate him lower in points leagues (about picks 35 to 50) than in category leagues.
With a March 28 end, Cleveland plays 4, 3 and 2 games in the fantasy playoffs, with a two-game week starting March 22 in the final.
Cleveland has the most back-to-backs in the league.
He has no current injury concerns.
Cleveland is projected to win about 51 to 53 games. Coach Kenny Atkinson is under pressure.

durable.text: He is still an elite source of assists.
His high FT% on good volume lifts a team's FT%, but he gets to the free throw line less than before.
His FG% is low for a guard. His shooting has fallen off, and his two-point percentage is not ideal.
He commits many turnovers, which hurts the TO category clearly.
He no longer gives much in steals and blocks.
He is 37 and showed his age last season.

note: Our league paid 42 USD for him last season. Yahoo values him at 27 USD, ESPN at 28 USD, and a recent auction mock sold him for 24 USD, so bid in the low to mid 20s and do not pay round-two money. He fits punt FG% and punt TO builds best, giving elite assists, strong FT% and threes. Early in the season, check his minutes (about 33 at the end of last season), his usage next to Mitchell, and whether the two stagger. Also remember his two-game finals week.
